notes: Six builds present large flat regions = pinned-stage signature; treated as uncapturable not dead space, so their middle acts are largely unassessed and continuity rests on transport labels. V11 above all could not be fairly assessed - strongest single frame in the pool but every capture landed on Act 00 with no copy visible, so its ranking is DELIBERATELY HELD AT FIFTH rather than higher until someone confirms the page has readable content. Nine of eleven use a fixed bottom transport with timecode and named acts; nine are dark; amber-on-near-black recurs in seven. Only V09 commits to light and explicit 3D perspective. Most common failure across the pool: fixed header or transport bar overlapping body text (V03, V06, V08, V10).
